caption:
Venta Borinc için doğru saklama rehberi: uygun koşullarda raf ömrü 3 yıldır.

Nerede? Serin, kuru, iyi havalandırılan ve güneş almayan bir yerde, 5°C – 45°C arasında saklayınız.

Nasıl? Orijinal ambalajında, ağzı kapalı muhafaza ediniz. Açılan ambalajı sıkıca kapatıp kısa sürede tüketiniz. Gıda, yem ve ilaçlardan ayrı; çocukların ve hayvanların erişemeyeceği yerlerde tutunuz.

Kullanmadan önce etiketi okuyunuz.

#Venta #MTMAgro #Borinc #BitkiBesleme
rationale: The cover opens with the one hard number on the label (3-year shelf life under proper conditions) and asks 'Bu koşullar neler?'; slides 2 and 3 answer with where and how, each led by one wide black italic display line and a label-like spec table taken word for word from the storage statements. The first-pass system was sound (forest cover, paper content slides, fixed counter, eyebrow and sign-off positions), so I kept it and fixed composition instead of starting over: the cover's hook now belongs to the headline instead of floating above the footer, and slide 3 finally shows the closed original pack next to 'AĞZI KAPALI', so the carousel is recognisably Venta. No doses, percentages or claims beyond facts.json were needed.

critique.issue: Cover: the hook line sits ~370px below the headline and only ~106px above the sign-off, so it reads as part of the footer; the middle of the slide is an accidental hole and 'Bu koşullar neler?' loses its link to the headline it continues.
critique.fix: Move the subhead into the intro group directly under the headline (32px, the headline-to-body step) so headline and hook read as one statement in the upper two thirds; the lower field stays deliberately open above the sign-off, as in the DESIGN.md statement archetype.

critique.issue: The product never appears. Apart from the logo and the cover eyebrow, the carousel could be any brand's storage notice, and slide 3 says 'orijinal ambalajında' without showing the pack.
critique.fix: Place the Venta Borinc pack shot on slide 3 in the empty area right of 'AĞZI KAPALI': bag right edge on the 1008px margin, as tall as the two headline lines, 64px above the table, on white with multiply, no type over it.

critique.issue: Spec labels and the URL are 24px (linter small-font-size warnings on every slide); at phone scale (~8.6pt) the grey letter-spaced caps are the weakest text on the slides.
critique.fix: Raise spec labels and the URL to 28px; reduce label tracking from 0.12em to 0.10em so the larger caps stay compact inside the 296px label column.

critique.issue: Slide 3: 'Sıkıca kapatıp kısa / sürede tüketin.' splits the phrase 'kısa sürede' across lines.
critique.fix: Break by meaning: 'Sıkıca kapatıp / kısa sürede tüketin.'

critique.issue: At leading 0.96 the dot of İ in REHBERİ sits only ~12px under the baseline of SAKLAMA; tight at feed size, the exact collision DESIGN.md warns about.
critique.fix: Display leading 0.96 to 1.0 in the shared style, so every slide gets the same clearance.

critique.issue: The VENTA wordmark at 44px is a second wide black italic mass that competes with the display headline on the white slides.
critique.fix: Logo 44px to 40px tall, kept on the same sign-off centre line as the URL, identical on all three slides.

changes: Slide 1: 'subhead' moved from its own absolute position (top 1040) into the 'intro' group, 32px under the headline; layer id kept.

Slide 3: new image layer 'product-photo' (/brand/assets/product-venta-borinc.png, 416x416 box at left 685 / top 221, about 35% of native size so no upscaling); the bag lands at about x 778-1008, y 301-574, right-aligned to the margin and level with the headline; mix-blend-mode: multiply via the new shared '.pack' class so the photo's white margin cannot cover the headline or the table rule.
Shared style: .spec-label 24px to 28px and tracking 0.12em to 0.10em; .web 24px to 28px. This clears all small-font-size warnings (no linter errors were reported).
Shared style: .lede gets max-width 776px so the hook keeps a body-text measure inside the full-width intro group.

Slide 3: explicit break 'Sıkıca kapatıp
kısa sürede tüketin.'
Sign-off on all slides: logo height 44 to 40px (top 1232 to 1234); URL top 1238 to 1236 for the 28px size; both stay centred on y 1254.
Caption rewritten: the shelf-life hook as the first line, one 'Nerede?' and one 'Nasıl?' paragraph using only the storage statements, closing with 'Kullanmadan önce etiketi okuyunuz.' and 4 hashtags.
